messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: GCP Partner Rep <gcp-partner@gcp-partner.google.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: GCP engagement orientation + deal pulse — Acme Health

Team,

Quick note to align on the Acme Health opportunity before tomorrow's joint call with GCP and their internal stakeholders.

Background: Acme is evaluating a production inference path for clinical note summarization. GCP's field rep asked for a short playbook and a consolidated risk list so they can advance co-sell prioritization.

Asks:
- Vanessa: can you lead the GCP PM alignment and confirm which GCP reps will attend (regional SE + partner lead)?
- Laura: please bring the current pricing band and the mutual action plan (MAP) you shared last week.
- Marcus: can you pull the preliminary perf numbers for med-text-encoder (latency @ 2k tokens) so we can answer ops questions.

I've dropped a draft joint playbook and MAP into Drive (link below) — if you have high-impact edits please flag them by EOD today. We'll use the playbook on the call as our single source of truth.

Proposed meeting agenda (30m):
1) Intros + success criteria (5m)
2) High-level architecture & perf expectations (8m)
3) Commercial ask & next steps (10m)
4) Risks & gating items (7m)

Attachments: GCP_Joint_Playbook_v0.3.pdf, Acme_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGacme-playbook

Thanks,

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partner PM, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-11T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP engagement orientation + deal pulse — Acme Health

Karthik,

Thanks — good framing. I can lead the GCP side. Confirmed attendees from GCP:
- Priya Rao (Partner Lead) — will join
- Mike Chan (Field SE) — may dial in for arch/perf

Small edits to the agenda:
- Move commercial ask earlier so procurement can confirm timing (swap 2 & 3)
- Add a 5-minute fallback path discussion (model variants + fallback routing) — Acme cares about availability

I'll update the playbook with a short GCP intro paragraph and drop a note in the Drive. Laura, can you paste the MAP tab "Commercial milestones" into the Drive sheet? Marcus, if you can add a perf table (p95 latency at seq lengths 512/1024/2048), that'll be perfect.

I'll schedule the joint call for tomorrow 11:00am PT and include the GCP reps.

Vanessa

Date: 2027-06-11T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP engagement orientation + deal pulse — Acme Health

Karthik/Vanessa,

Thanks for the context — we confirm 11:00am PT tomorrow works.

A few notes from Acme:
- Success metric: reduce clinician note review time by 40% within pilot.
- Data constraints: PHI redaction required at ingest; we'll need to discuss KMS options and log retention (we must keep logs for 7 years per policy).
- Procurement will want a one-page summary of pricing bands and a proposed pilot contract SOW.

Attached: high-level pilot SOW stub (SOW_Acme_pilot_stub.docx) — Ana will be on the call to go through procurement questions.

Sara

Subject: Re: GCP engagement orientation + deal pulse — Acme Health

Thanks everyone — quick recap and next steps:

Decisions:
- Meeting set: 2027-06-12 11:00am PT
- GCP attendees: Priya Rao, Mike Chan

Action owners (before call):
- Vanessa: finalize GCP intro paragraph & schedule invite (IN PROGRESS)
- Laura: paste Commercial milestones into Drive (due today EOD)
- Marcus: upload perf table (p95 @ 512/1024/2048) and call out any known latency regressions (due today EOD)
- Karthik: prepare the 1-pager pricing + pilot SOW summary for procurement (I'll draft and circulate prior to call)
- Ana/Sara: prepare procurement questions and the SOW stub (Ana to present)

Risks to flag for GCP review:
- KMS integration timeline may push pilot start by 2-3 weeks if Acme insists on enterprise HSM.
- Data retention requirements (7-year logs) require ops alignment on storage & cost estimates.

I'll circulate a 1-pager and a slim slide with the architecture and perf table before 10:00am PT.

Karthik
